aboutGame.title: What is Resident Evil 0?
paragraphs: Resident Evil 0 is a survival horror game from Capcom and a prequel to the original Resident Evil. Set in 1998, it follows S.T.A.R.S. medic Rebecca Chambers and escaped convict Billy Coen as they uncover the truth behind the Umbrella Corporation's experiments.

The HD Remaster modernizes the classic experience with updated visuals, widescreen support, and additional content such as Wesker Mode. Our wiki covers every area, puzzle, weapon, and boss with detailed guides and reference tables.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Resident Evil 0.

items.question: What is Resident Evil 0?
items.answer: Resident Evil 0 is a survival horror prequel from Capcom. Set in 1998, it follows Rebecca Chambers and Billy Coen as they investigate the Umbrella Corporation's experiments aboard the Ecliptic Express and beyond.

items.question: Which platforms is Resident Evil 0 on?
items.answer: The HD Remaster is available on PC via Steam, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch.

items.question: Who are the playable characters?
items.answer: You alternate between Rebecca Chambers, a S.T.A.R.S. medic, and Billy Coen, an escaped convict. Character switching and partner zapping are central to the game.

items.question: Is there a Wesker Mode?
items.answer: Yes. The HD Remaster includes Wesker Mode, which lets you play through the campaign with Albert Wesker's special abilities.

items.question: Do I need to play other Resident Evil games first?
items.answer: No. Resident Evil 0 is a prequel, so it is a fine starting point, though returning fans will recognize many characters and locations.

bosses.overviewDescription: Complete guides for every boss encounter in Resident Evil 0, from the Ecliptic Express to the final Queen Leech showdown.
bosses.body: Bosses in Resident Evil 0 test your resource management and positioning as much as your aim. Early encounters such as the giant scorpion aboard the Ecliptic Express teach you to keep your distance and use the environment. Later fights, including the giant bat, the Centurion, and the Proto Tyrant, demand careful weapon selection and healing management across both characters. The final confrontation with the Queen Leech brings the story to a close. Use the guides below to prepare for every fight and learn the tactics that make each encounter manageable.
